flow_method: estimated from each home's net power (demand minus delivered solar); losses ignored

provenance.solar: modeled: solar v2 day-ahead forecast (five weather models, LightGBM, conformal)
provenance.demand: modeled: CEEW 2019-2021 climatology by month and day type; homes from analog days
provenance.voltage: modeled: upstream-voltage model; yesterday's mean from the same date of an earlier year (proxy)
provenance.grid: benchmark: SimBench topology with IS 398 conductors; homes on single phases
